description: Measure how systematic an existing UI really is: paste CSS / SCSS / Tailwind / JSX source and get a consistency score plus the sprawl behind it — how many distinct colors, font sizes, radii, shadows and spacing values it actually uses, which colors are near-duplicates nobody can tell apart, which spacing is off the 4pt grid, token adoption, stray font families, !important and magic z-index. Returns a consolidation plan wired to the generators. Use it before a redesign, on an inherited codebase, or to prove a design system is (or isn't) being followed. Deterministic static analysis; complements design_lint (per-line anti-patterns) with a whole-codebase view.

code.description: The stylesheet / token file / component source to audit. Concatenate several files to audit them together.

name: audit_design_system
title: Audit Design System
